name: tanvis
description: Browser-first visualisation library for scanning data-driven containers and rendering visualisations for Tanyptera project.

scripts.build:wp: rollup -c && node -e "const fs=require('fs');fs.mkdirSync('wordpress/tanvis/assets',{recursive:true});for(const f of fs.readdirSync('dependencies'))fs.copyFileSync('dependencies/'+f,'wordpress/tanvis/assets/'+f);fs.copyFileSync('dist/tanvis.iife.js','wordpress/tanvis/assets/tanvis.iife.js');for(const d of ['vcs/simp-100','vcs/hectad-grids','images'])fs.cpSync('data/'+d,'wordpress/tanvis/assets/data/'+d,{recursive:true})" && tar -a -c -f wordpress/tanvis.zip -C wordpress/tanvis tanvis.php assets
